summary: Short campus through-road kerb with no cars parked and no parking lane.

drivers.seclusion: Lawn, courts and university buildings 18 m or more away, no homes, but the kerb is in plain view.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs along the lane with a narrow lawn strip behind; no pull-in and no marked parking bay.
drivers.traffic: Campus road with buses and cars; steady daytime traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars on this stretch; the parked row starts further west.

flags: Painted symbols on the carriageway beside the stretch
Low-lying: about 6 m elevation, Brisbane River 249 m away
sun_shade: Tree canopy to the north-west shades the west end; east end open.
